q: In the MCP 2026-07-28 specification, how does a server learn the client’s protocol version and capabilities?
options: From the initialize handshake at the start of the session
From the _meta field carried on each request
explain: The stateless design removed the handshake and sessions; every request carries its version and capabilities in `_meta`.

q: How many MCP clients does a host create when it connects to three servers?
explain: A host creates one client per server connection.

q: Why do stateless requests make remote MCP servers easier to scale?
options: Any replica behind a load balancer can answer any request, because nothing depends on earlier messages
explain: Without sessions, requests are self-contained, like ordinary stateless web services.
